description:
[FREE] Get a real underwriting decision on a loan to an AI agent.
principal  = requested loan size in USDC.
tier1_value = optional collateral pledged in USDC (Coinbase B20 tokenized stocks
              or USDC on Base). Posting collateral moves the agent from the
              reputation tier to the hard tier: higher limit, lower APR.
Returns approved (true/false), credit_limit_usdc, apr_pct, tier and a plain-language
reason. This declines - roughly half of all requests are refused - so treat a
decline as a real signal about the counterparty.
Free and unauthenticated. The decision is advisory: settle it in your own contract
or through the SolvScore credit manager on Base L2.
name: underwrite_agent_loan
